name: +1 Speed Motorcycle Escape
desc:
Welcome to +1 Speed Motorcycle Escape! 🚲

How to Play:
🚲Every ride makes you faster!
🏃Go through the obstacles to get wins!
⚡Unlock new motorbikes that give insane big boosts!
🔥Rebirth to unlock new perks!
💪Train on treadmills or sprint across the map to gain speed

If you’re having fun, don't forget to like the game! 👍
